reconstruction_settings.pulsating_sequence: Command +U, -U, 0 with one sample actuation latency; realized pulse group 0, +U, -U.
reconstruction_settings.angle_update: Hold the estimated angle over a pulse pair and integrate the observer after the two slope measurements.
reconstruction_settings.simulation_observer_damping_basis: Use Fig. 8 damping for the independent standstill runs. Section IV does not provide a simulation-specific value.
reconstruction_settings.torque_feedforward: zero in the independent locked-rotor observer
reconstruction_settings.standstill_voltage_model: Linear locked rotor, ideal held voltage and independent event-resolved two-level SVPWM.
reconstruction_settings.rtvi_verification: Ideal steady-state demodulator and observer transfer function. Original BPF/LPF, rotating injection frequency and filter time alignment were not disclosed.
